summary: Indexed critical-section release helper: given an index a1, selects the critical section stored at offset a1 within the global table rooted at dword_5E6C80 and calls LeaveCriticalSection on it. Mirrors the enter/init helpers in the same address range that treat dword_5E6C80 as an array of CRITICAL_SECTION objects.

operations.description: Compute the critical-section address as (&dword_5E6C80 + a1), i.e. a1 steps through the global critical-section table rooted at dword_5E6C80 (read-only here).
Release the selected critical section via LeaveCriticalSection (read at 0x0059E170), dereferencing the computed table entry.

Called as the release half of critical-section pairs across the engine, e.g. CriticalSectionLeave (0x00589D74), AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave (0x0058C203), CriticalSectionLeave_c232 (0x0058C232), CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter (0x0058DFEA), LazyInitSingletonWithFlagGuard (0x005921C5) and CriticalSectionGuardedCall (0x0059247A).

unresolved: Element count and stride of the dword_5E6C80 table, and whether a1 is validated before indexing.
The enter counterparts and table initialization live in sibling functions outside this packet.
